name: tadazz
description: Connect your Tadazz account to create, edit, preview, save, and export quiz drafts.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit quiz drafts in your Tadazz account, preview them in the conversation, and save a selected draft after approving it in Tadazz. Preview interactions are demonstrations and do not cast live votes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a five-question quiz draft in Tadazz and show its interactive preview.
